answers.transcript: The ~~annual~~ Annual Prize Giving Ceremony of our school was really an excited event. The ceremony of our school was held on the last fifteenth January. We decorated every corner of the school compound with green leaves, festoon and colour papers. The auditorium and its dais were brightly decorated. Prizes were neatly displayed on a separate table. The function started at 4 pm. Eve A Every students were present at the function. Sufficient sitting arrangements were made for the guests, teachers and the students. among students, guardians and some eminent persons of the locality attended the function. The function started at 4 pm. In the nick of time the chief guest came in his car. The formal cenemony began with the recitation from the holy Quran. Then the head master read out the annual examination results. After that, the chief guest gave a short speech. He highly praised the overall result in JSC and SSC of our schools. Then After the function, we staged a drama. Really, the function very enjoyable.

Here is a dialogue between Myself and Shelia about the last annual examination result.

Myself : Hello, Shelia! How are you?
Shelia : I am fines thank you. What's about you?
Myself : I am fine, too. Our annual examination results are finally out. How did you do?
Shelia : Hey, Jobayer! I did pretty well. I scored 87% overall. I am quite happy with marks. How did you do?
Myself : Congratulations! I got 82%. I was hoping for a little bit more. But I guess it's not too bad.
Shelia : That's a great result, too. Don't be dissapointed. You worked hard and it reflects that. Which subject did you score the highest in?
Myself : Mathematics. I got 94. I was really confident about it. But English pulled my percentage down.
Shelia : Wow! 94 in Math is incredible. Don't worry about English. You can improve it next time. I bit struggled with science. But I managed to get an 85.
Myself : That's good. Let's celebrate our results and learn from mistakes.
Shelia : That's a great idea. Let's learn from our mistakes and aim even bigger.
Myself : Thank you.
Shelia : You're the most welcome.
